name: Learn anything
author: RdotA
description: Explanations, quizzes and study plans for any topic.

prompts.title: Explain simply
prompts.text: Explain {ask:Topic} as if I'm new to it: start with the big idea, then the key parts, then one everyday example.

prompts.title: Quiz me
prompts.text: Quiz me on {ask:Topic}. Ask one question at a time, wait for my answer, tell me if I'm right and why, then ask the next. Start easy and get harder.

prompts.title: Study plan
prompts.text: Make a {ask:How many weeks}-week study plan for learning {ask:Topic}, with goals, resources and a small project for each week.

prompts.title: Compare two things
prompts.text: Compare {ask:First thing} and {ask:Second thing}: what each is for, how they differ, and when to choose which. Finish with a short table.

prompts.title: Analogy please
prompts.text: Give me three different analogies that explain {ask:Concept}, and say where each one breaks down.
